content_review.query_counting: Case-insensitive exact phrase matching; six shorter selected phrases are included within longer selected phrases. This is 26 distinct approved query strings, not 26 independent insertion locations.

facts_and_sources.claim: Яндекс описывает использование данных взаимодействия пользователей с результатами поиска при оценке качества поиска.
facts_and_sources.scope_limit: Это не подтверждает эффект конкретной кампании или обработку синтетических сигналов.

facts_and_sources.claim: Яндекс относит имитацию визитов из поиска к поисковому спаму и может ограничивать ранжирование. Для внутренней проверки не делались ложные заявления о безопасности или рекомендации Яндекса.
facts_and_sources.public_framing_basis: Действующие editorial public-framing rules; в статье прямо сказано, что активность искусственная.

facts_and_sources.claim: Бессвязные списки ключей и переоптимизация без пользы нарушают правила. Exact keywords проверены вместе с читательской естественностью.
Отправка на переобход не означает включения страницы в поиск. В статье нет обещания срока индексации.
Площадка требует осмысленный структурированный оригинальный материал для аудитории интернет-торговли и права на изображения; внешнее размещение рассматривает владелец.

Бот открывает в поисковой выдаче несколько других результатов, целевой сайт последним, затем в поиск не возвращается и внутри сайта действий не совершает. Публичное описание ограничено искусственными поисковыми переходами.
Магазин светильников — явно условная иллюстрация бизнес-логики; не реальный кейс, статистика или доказательство эффективности кампании.

final_prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square 1:1 editorial cover photograph for a serious Russian ecommerce business article explaining why a prepared online shop competes for customer attention in search. Scene: an actual modest contemporary lighting showroom in Russia, shelves of ordinary pendant lights and table lamps in the background. Subject: a thoughtful female small-business owner around 38, in simple cream shirt and muted blue cardigan, standing at a wooden display table, attentively positioning one attractive ceramic table lamp among a small coherent selection. Capture a credible working moment of curating an offer, not posing. Composition: square 1:1 photo, medium environmental composition, face and hands and selected lamp centered safely for mobile crop, natural perspective. Soft daylight, real skin, restrained authentic colours and slight tactile documentary grain, moderate contrast. No devices, no laptop, no phone, no screens, no visualized interfaces, no graphs, no text, no logos, no arrows, no brand marks, no watermarks, no staged smile or handshake, no glossy AI advertising look. This is an illustrative fictional scene, not a specific person or actual business.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape 3:2 editorial photograph, Russian ecommerce article section about competition between similar offers BEFORE the customer chooses a retailer. Scene: an ordinary small lighting wholesaler showroom workshop in Russia, daylight through large industrial windows. Main action: a male shop merchandiser in his forties carefully compares two distinct pendant lamp samples side by side on a long clean work table, one black dome and one pale ceramic bell; he measures their size with a plain measuring tape, preparing an assortment for an online kitchen-lighting category. Several other sensible product samples in the distance. Composition: 3:2 landscape, wide environmental frame from across table, show real room depth and products as protagonist, face secondary, safe centered crop. Authentic candid work, natural skin, realistic hands, subdued practical blue-grey clothes, tactile materials, restrained colours, moderate contrast. No laptop, phone, screens, readable paperwork, text, labels, logos, graphs, arrows, watermarks, smiling pose, handshakes, glossy AI look. Do not show same woman or same room as previous cover; distinct setting. Fictional illustrative scene, not a documented case.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape 3:2 editorial photograph supporting article section about an online shop being commercially ready to fulfil the orders that search visibility may bring. Scene: practical small ecommerce packing station in a Russian warehouse. Observable action: close documentary view of an employee carefully inspecting the cable connector and included mounting hardware of a compact unbranded wall lamp laid on protective kraft paper beside an open shipping carton, before packing it. Only torso and realistic hands of worker wearing grey cotton work shirt, no face required. Lamp and small complete hardware set are clear center of action. Background: softly blurred shelves, neat packing supplies. Composition: 3:2 horizontal, tight detail from a natural diagonal top-down angle, distinctive from a showroom or desk meeting. Natural sidelight, tactile metal and paper, honest colours, moderate contrast, real hands and physically coherent hardware. No laptop, phone, screen, charts, readable labels, text, logos, arrows, watermarks, glossy advertising, duplicate objects or extra fingers. Fictional illustrative business scene.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape 3:2 editorial photograph for Russian ecommerce article section about choosing a specific limited promotion scope and agreeing how to evaluate it. Scene: modest real Russian small-business meeting room with daylight, unremarkable wooden table. Observable action: a female ecommerce manager around 40 and male consultant around 30 seriously compare three printed product-category photo sheets, the woman marks one selected group with a pencil while the man points to the same sheet. Printed sheets contain small product photographs of lamps with simple blank fields and no readable text, no charts. Only two people, natural expressions and real hands. Composition: 3:2 horizontal, medium over-shoulder view from behind consultant towards manager and papers, papers and interaction centered, softly visible simple office plants and storage in background. Documentary photo, real skin texture and fabric, calm natural tones, small muted blue clothing detail, moderate contrast. Absolutely no screens, laptops, phones, fake interface, readable writing, graphs, logos, arrows, watermarks, handshakes, stock-photo smiles or AI gloss. Visually distinct from showroom and warehouse pictures. Fictional illustrative scene, not actual documented client.
